The '''Griagh''' was a monstrous, four-headed creature that dwelled in a large cave system on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Although it was long considered to be legendary, the Griagh was real indeed, and it was [[Destruction of the Dulok Swamp|awakened]] late in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a [[Endor shield generator bunker|bunker]] on the moon. After leaving a trail of devastation, the Griagh was killed by the power of the [[Sunstar/Legends|Sunstar]], which was destroyed in the process.
